diagnosis.original_evidence: At exact current head, R30BeforeScreenDrawForSkyGlow correctly checks ScreenHud/ScreenOverlay2D; later R30TryScreenSpaceFovDraw unconditionally calls R30CaptureSkyGlowSceneBeforeHud for even exact C993 WorldBillboard. In a world-first presentation that may freeze pre-HUD stereo bloom before the central sun is drawn.
diagnosis.root_cause: Owned-eye path used an unconditional pre-HUD SkyGlow snapshot where the outer/delegated draw path already demanded actual UI semantics. The conflicting boundaries cut world lens contributions out of the captured bloom source.
source_trace: D3A5 source -> exact C993 LensFlareCentre -> WorldBillboard semantic selects R26+HUD R30 FOV per-eye Draw.
R30BeforeScreenDrawForSkyGlow classified only ScreenHud/ScreenOverlay2D, but R30TryScreenSpaceFovDraw captured unconditionally ahead of first world/scene effect.
Both now share IsSkyGlowPreHudBoundary, leaving world billboards and effects to accumulate until first actual screen UI; SkyGlow Present unchanged.
alternatives_rejected: Do not promote all alpha world effects into ScreenHud, force lens alpha to zero, globally disable SkyGlow, change time logic, or claim central optical diplopia fixed without HMD.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R30 selected packaged renderer gates owned-eye capture by same semantic as outer entry; constexpr compiled policy + host runtime negative assertions + four source mutations in exact-SHA active CI.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: WorldBillboard, SceneEffect, WorldParticle, projected marker/effect, SkyGlow and None all deny UI snapshot; ScreenHud and ScreenOverlay2D allow; four fail-after mutations guard both call paths.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Left and right reduced source surfaces are copied by unchanged R30CaptureSkyGlowSceneBeforeHud; first actual screen producer cuts off both eyes and original world FOV drawing and SkyGlow composite remain unchanged.

runtime_evidence: No game or Quest3/VDXR HMD execution; source-proven world/HUD capture boundary only. Original lens center diplopia remains NEED_HMD_TEST.
